findings.claim: The v5 version block attributes a cvx-2015 latency range of 0.366–0.380 s to 'the 2026-08-20 trio', but the trio reads 0.366–0.374 s; 0.380 is the 20260820-115810 artifact's value, which is not one of the three runs named.
findings.evidence: docs/analysis-report.md:16-19: '(on the 2026-08-20 trio those two filings read 0.366–0.380 s and 0.500–0.521 s; …)'. evals/report/20260820-031501/-031540/-031620-bench.json records[cvx-2015].median_s = 0.3656 / 0.3679 / 0.374; 20260820-115810 = 0.38 (and 024620 = 0.3739). The bac-2006 half (0.500–0.521) does reproduce from the trio (0.5002/0.5052/0.5213). The figure sits beyond --check-docs' reach (no backticked fixture name within 60 chars before it), so the instrument could not catch it.
findings.repro: python3 -c "import json;[print(s,{r['fixture']:r['median_s'] for r in json.load(open(f'evals/report/{s}-bench.json'))['records']}['cvx-2015']) for s in ('20260820-031501','20260820-031540','20260820-031620','20260820-115810')]"
findings.acceptance: The sentence reads 0.366–0.374 s for the trio, or names the population it actually spans (the four 2026-08-20 clean-tree runs, 0.366–0.380 s) — re-derived from the artifacts, not edited by hand.
